entries.answers: Is this business entity registered, active, and in good standing in Texas? Who is its registered agent, what is its entity number, status, and filing history?
entries.notes: SOSDirect: $1.00 statutory fee per search; pre-funded SOSDirect account required (temporary one-off login supported). Verified via live fetch of official page. Free alternative for tax standing only: Texas Comptroller Taxable Entity Search (franchise tax account status, right to transact business, officers on Public Information Reports). Automated clients may receive a bot challenge (403) on this portal - access it with a real browser session.

entries.answers: Is this business entity registered, active, and in good standing in Washington? Who is its registered agent, what is its entity number, status, and filing history?
entries.notes: Corporations and Charities Filing System (CCFS); search is free. State guidance says users should create an account to file online and conduct searches, so a free account may be required for search access.

entries.answers: Is this business entity registered, active, and in good standing in Wyoming? Who is its registered agent, what is its entity number, status, and filing history?
entries.notes: WY Business Center filing search; free, no login. Search by filing name or Filing ID (e.g. 2000-000123456). Entities with names beginning with the letter 'A' require paper review.
